description:
Signal lane (Signal Engine S8, P-DAY.137): the LIVE SIGNAL CARDS — GET /api/v1/signals, the one read of them. A card is a compiled
    answer of one of three families: lead_lag (a dated lag between one market's events and another's), network (a change in the
    graph — an asset newly owned 50% or more by a blocked party, a company suddenly taking many new assets, one buyer taking a rising
    share), signature (a repeating pattern on a site — construction on the ground with no announcement, a stockpile change beyond its
    noise band, a stalled project). Each card: id, kind, family, title, summary, country, sector, severity (high | medium | low),
    entity_ids, compiled_at, expires_at and answer_sha256 (the hash of the answer exactly as compiled); once the ranked feed is live each
    card also carries rank_score with its parts (precision = the type's measured precision, lead_weight = what is left of its lead band,
    recency = a 28-day half-life) and the answer is ordered by it. A signal type puts cards here only while it is ARMED (its backtest met
    the floor: precision >= 0.6 on >= 20 adjudicated firings), and a weekly 28-day rolling precision disarms it below the floor; every answer
    carries armed_types (how many types are armed now) and armed_note. NO TYPE IS ARMED YET: today this answers 0 cards, which costs
    nothing. Metered per card DELIVERED (the compiled price for this route, 200 J a card today; an empty answer is 0 J; the cards your
    entity cap cannot admit are trimmed and the answer says so in entity_cap): quote first with billing_quote(path="/api/v1/signals",
    limit=N). Agent keys only. Signals are measured observations with their provenance, never advice: a card says what the graph shows
    and what question an adjudicator would answer; it is not a recommendation to buy, sell or hold anything.
    WHEN NOT TO CALL: a question about one entity's edges is `relationships`; "did this site change" is `entity_change`.Metered: charged to your own wallet — see the server instructions (CHARGING); quote first with `billing_quote`.
